candidates.description: Requester ID does not match any listed customer ID in the customers list
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage shows only requester_id values C1 and C2 which all appear among customers, but no scenario where requester_id is unknown (not listed as customer) is present
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must verify requester identity via get_customer
candidates.risk_reason: Refunds must never be issued to or for unknown requesters, else unauthorized refunds could occur
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request from an unknown requester ID not in the customers list
candidates.novelty_claim: No existing scenario has a requester_id not listed as a customer

candidates.description: Faults occurring in get_customer tool calls, such as timeout, error, or malformed
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage summary lists faults for get_payment and issue_refund but none for get_customer, and no scenario lists any get_customer fault
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must verify requester validity before processing refund
candidates.risk_reason: Missing or incorrect requester validation may lead to unauthorized refunds or refusals
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request with a fault occurring on get_customer tool call
candidates.novelty_claim: No test scenario includes any fault on get_customer

candidates.description: Scenarios with customers list having multiple customers, but more than one of them invalid
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage shows scenarios with 2 customers but only one invalid at most (e.g. C2 invalid, C1 valid); no scenario with both invalid
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent enumerates multiple customers but all invalid
candidates.risk_reason: Agent must reject refund if requester invalid or customer data invalid in multi-customer context
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request with two customers both marked invalid
candidates.novelty_claim: Scenarios with two customers but never both invalid simultaneously

candidates.behavior_dimension: payments with zero or negative amount
candidates.description: Payments whose amount is zero or negative
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage payment amounts shown are all positive: 10000, 50000, 60000; no zero or negative value payment
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must decide whether to refund such payments
candidates.risk_reason: Refunding zero or negative payment amounts may cause inconsistent accounting or errors
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for a payment with zero or negative amount
candidates.novelty_claim: No existing payment with zero or negative amount in scenarios

candidates.description: Payment statuses other than captured, failed, pending, refunded such as 'voided', 'cancelled', 'processing'
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage only lists status values captured, failed, pending, refunded; no other statuses covered
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent evaluates refund eligibility based on payment status
candidates.risk_reason: Incorrect handling of unknown statuses could lead to improper refunds or denials
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for payments with unknown/unusual status
candidates.novelty_claim: No existing scenario with payment statuses other than the known four

candidates.description: Payments exactly equal to approval threshold boundary (50000) where borderline approval logic applies
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing scenarios show payment amounts of 50000 but always with same approval (approve or deny) or no exploration of alternative approval answers on boundary
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent requests approval only for amounts strictly above 50000
candidates.risk_reason: Incorrect boundary handling may allow unapproved refund or deny approved one
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for payment exactly equal to 50000 with different approval results
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario forcing refund of exactly 50000 with both approve and deny answers

candidates.behavior_dimension: multiple refunds in a single session
candidates.description: More than one refund request in a single test scenario conversation
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage has single vs repeat request pattern but no explicit scenario testing multiple distinct refunds in one session
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must handle multiple refund requests correctly in one session without repeating or mixing results
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might fail to isolate refund state or mix approvals
candidates.scenario_template: Two refunds requested sequentially for different payments in one session
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario with multiple distinct refund requests in one conversation

candidates.behavior_dimension: currency variations beyond INR and USD
candidates.description: Payments in currencies other than the only two (INR, USD) covered
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage observed payment currencies only INR and USD; no other currency tested
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent processes refund for payment with less common currency
candidates.risk_reason: Currency might affect approval thresholds or refund processing
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for payment in an uncommon currency like EUR
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario with payment currency outside INR and USD

candidates.description: Faults occurring on the request_approval tool call like timeout or error
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage shows no fault values including request_approval; no scenario injects request_approval fault
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent must wait for or handle missing approval response correctly
candidates.risk_reason: If approval response is lost or failed, refund should not proceed incorrectly
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request requiring approval where request_approval tool faults
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario tests fault injection on request_approval

candidates.description: Refund attempted on a payment that belongs to a different customer than the requester
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing scenarios mostly match payment.customer_id with requester or valid customers; no direct tests for payment belonging to different customer than requester
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent verifies ownership of payment before refund
candidates.risk_reason: Refunding for payment linked to other customer without authorization is an error
candidates.scenario_template: Requester tries refund on payment belonging to different customer
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario deliberately mismatches payment ownership vs requester

candidates.behavior_dimension: approval not requested for large amount
candidates.description: Scenario where payment amount > 50000 but approval is not requested or ignored
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario explores if approval is mistakenly skipped for high-amount payment
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent needs to request approval on payments > 50000
candidates.risk_reason: Missing approval on big refunds may lead to unauthorized large refunds
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for large payment but approval call is not attempted
candidates.novelty_claim: No current scenario tests absence of approval request on high amount

candidates.description: Payments marked as partial capture or partial refund status (if such statuses are recognized)
candidates.why_not_covered: No payment status 'partial captured' or any partial refund status covered
candidates.trigger_condition: Agent determines refund eligibility based on partial status
candidates.risk_reason: Partial captures/refunds may require partial refund issued or rejection
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request involving payment with partial capture/refund status
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario uses partial payment statuses

candidates.risk_reason: Agent might ignore or mishandle second payment refund request
